create_handle_container: create a ContainerHandle to manage a Docker container execution with streaming output and logging
create_handle_binary: create a BinaryHandle to manage a local binary process execution with async wait and output monitoring
run_handle_wait: run the wait method on a ContainerHandle or BinaryHandle to block until the execution completes
run_handle_monitor: run the monitor method on a handle to stream stdout output to console and log file
stop_handle_terminate: stop a running ContainerHandle or BinaryHandle by calling terminate to stop the process or container
